component.name: Heronite
component.summary: Every game you own, on Linux, in one native launcher

description.p: Heronite gathers Epic Games, sideloaded and Steam games and emulated ROMs in one Collection, and launches them with Wine, Proton or natively.

ul.li: Statuses, ratings, playtime, sessions and statistics for every game
Metadata and artwork from IGDB, Steam and Lutris
Wine and Proton manager, save backups with Ludusavi
